title: Mix_Hammers
description: This mod adds a lot of gadgets for the mine and not only, solves many problems of the vanilla version of Minecraft!
body:
This mod aims to improve game mechanics, specifically mining. You'll be able to craft tools such as
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

a hammer that digs 3 by 3

</details> or for example 
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

a miner's helmet that gives you night vision

</details> and many more items that will help you in mining, there is also a new biome
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

consisting of amethyst trees and deep slate!

</details> but to do this you will need to go to the mines and find a rare ore called
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Mix ore

</details> 


 This will greatly diversify your game and make it even better!
